outline:
This course covers the following topics:
1. Number systems and conversion
2. Boolean algebra
3. Simplification of Boolean algebra
4. Gate Circuits
5. Combinational Circuit Design
6. Flip-Flops, Registers, and Counters
7. Sequential Circuits
8. State Graphs and Tables
schedule:
Week 1. Introduction
Week 2. Boolean Algebra & Logical Gates (I)
Week 3. Boolean Algebra & Logical Gates (II)
Week 4. Minterm and Maxterm Expansions
Week 5. Karnaugh Maps
Week 6. Quine-McClusky Method
Week 7. Multi-Level Gate Circuits
Week 8. Combinational Circuit Design and Simulation Using Gates
Week 9. Midterm Exam
Week 10. Multiplexers, Decoders, and Programmable Logic Devices
Week 11. Latches and Flip-Flops (I)
Week 12. Latches and Flip-Flops (II)
Week 13. Registers and Counters (I)
Week 14. Registers and Counters (II)
Week 15. Analysis of Clocked Sequential Circuits
Week 16. Derivation of State Graphs and Tables (I)
Week 17. Derivation of State Graphs and Tables (II)
Week 18. Final Exam
assessment:
Homework exams 20%
Midterm 30%
Final 40%
Attendance 10%
Class Participation 10%
